blocks.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of STO 114.1(a), all-terrain vehicles may be operated on streets, highways and elsewhere in the City by law enforcement officers performing law enforcement duties. (Ord. 19652 § 5, 10-11-11.)

text:
Notwithstanding the provisions of STO 114.1(a), all-terrain vehicles may be operated on streets, highways and elsewhere in the City by law enforcement officers performing law enforcement duties. (Ord. 19652 § 5, 10-11-11.)
Cross References: Police Department, TMC 2.20.090 .
title: Operation of all-terrain vehicle by law enforcement.
